notes: The marginal alternative 'Or, through error' was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
The supplied and between unwittingly and unawares is added: no waw stands between the two prepositional phrases (rule 14's closing sentences); the ASV italic corroborates without deciding (rule 7).

Flagged unit בִּבְלִי־דָעַת → unawares retained: the one English word carries the manner, the negation and the knowledge, so rule 30's condition is met and no morpheme owns a part of it; headed on the negative as rule 48 heads a one-word מִבְּלִי. Heading on דַעַת was the competing reading.
נֶפֶשׁ → any person takes the supplied quantifying determiner under rule 15, since no כֹּל stands in this clause — unlike JOS.20.9, where כָּל is written.
